Container.Name: Photos
Container.Overview: Self-hosted Google Photos alternative built on Immich, with automatic phone backup, face recognition, smart search, albums, a WhatsApp-style family feed and full Hindi translation. This is the main web app and server. It needs the Photos-Postgres, Photos-Redis and Photos-ML containers from this repository.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: photos immich google photos backup gallery
Container.Requires: Install Photos-Postgres, Photos-Redis and Photos-ML first. See the README for the full setup.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Port for the web app and the Android app.

Config.Name: Photo library
Config.Description: Where uploaded photos and videos are stored.

Config.Name: Database host
Config.Description: IP address of your Unraid server, where Photos-Postgres runs.

Config.Name: Database password
Config.Description: Must match Photos-Postgres. Letters and numbers only.

Config.Name: Redis host
Config.Description: IP address of your Unraid server, where Photos-Redis runs.

Config.Name: Machine learning URL
Config.Description: Address of Photos-ML. Replace YOUR-UNRAID-IP with your server IP.
